conversation.text: Makan malik ka phone aaya tha, agle mahine se kiraya 45 hazar se 55 hazar kar raha hai

conversation.speaker: Owais
conversation.text: Das hazar ka izafa? Ye to seedha seedha loot hai, humein abhi saal bhi poora nahi hua

conversation.speaker: Shiraz
conversation.text: Uska kehna hai ke aas paas ke flats ka kiraya 60 hazar chal raha hai

conversation.speaker: Hammad
conversation.text: Wo bhi galat nahi keh raha, pichle hafte neeche wale flat ka ad dekha tha, 58 ka tha

conversation.speaker: Owais
conversation.text: To kya hum nikal jayein? Naya ghar dhoondo, shifting karo, advance do, sab dobara?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Nikalne ki baat abhi mat karo. Pehle usse 50 par razi karte hain, aur saath mein keh dete hain ke agle do saal ka agreement likh de taake kiraya dobara na barhe

conversation.speaker: Shiraz
conversation.text: Agreement wali baat achi hai, usko bhi tasalli rahegi ke hum chhor kar nahi jayenge

conversation.speaker: Hammad
conversation.text: @Me tum hi baat kar lo us se, tum ne hi pichli dafa pani ki motor theek karwane par usko manaya tha

conversation.speaker: Nadia
conversation.text: Kal ki meeting mein boss ne puchha ke quarterly report late kyun gayi, aur sab ki nazar mujh par thi

conversation.speaker: Faheem
conversation.text: Report to meri figures ka intezar kar rahi thi, aur maine to Monday ko hi bhej di thi

conversation.speaker: Sumbul
conversation.text: Mujhe lagta hai marketing walon ne apna data late diya, humari taraf se kuch deri nahi hui

conversation.speaker: Nadia
conversation.text: Phir bhi bhugatna to mujhe hi parega, report meri hai

conversation.speaker: Faheem
conversation.text: Boss ko ye sab batane ka koi faida nahi, wo sirf nateeja dekhte hain

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Blame game se kuch nahi hoga. Hum email thread nikaal kar timeline bana lete hain ke kis ne kab kya bheja, aur agli dafa deadline se do din pehle sab ka data lene ka system bana lete hain

conversation.speaker: Sumbul
conversation.text: Timeline wali baat theek hai, is se boss ko bhi saaf nazar aa jayega

conversation.speaker: Nadia
conversation.text: @Me kya tum ye timeline aaj hi bana kar mujhe bhej sakte ho? Kal subah boss se baat karni hai

conversation.speaker: Rubina
conversation.text: Khala ne Imran ke liye ek rishta dekha hai, ladki Lahore ki hai aur MBA kar rahi hai

conversation.speaker: Imran
conversation.text: Yaar abhi to meri naukri bhi pakki nahi hui, itni jaldi shaadi ki baat?

conversation.speaker: Ayesha
conversation.text: Sirf milne mein kya harj hai? Rishta tay thori hota hai pehli mulaqat mein

conversation.speaker: Rubina
conversation.text: Khala jaan bohot zor de rahi hain, kehti hain ke itna acha khandan baar baar nahi milta

conversation.speaker: Imran
conversation.text: Mujhe dabao mein mat daalo, main apni marzi se faisla karunga

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Imran, tumhari baat bilkul jaiz hai. Khala se seedha keh do ke tum ek saal naukri mein jam kar phir baat karoge, lekin mulaqat mein koi nuqsan nahi, wo bhi khush ho jayengi

conversation.speaker: Ayesha
conversation.text: Ye beech ka raasta sahi lag raha hai, na khala naraz na Imran pareshan

conversation.speaker: Rubina
conversation.text: @Me tum Imran ko khala se baat karne ke liye taiyar kar do, wo tumhari baat manta hai

conversation.speaker: Taha
conversation.text: Naran ka plan 5 din ka hai, mera andaza hai ke ek bande ka kharcha 35 hazar tak aayega

conversation.speaker: Hira
conversation.text: 35 hazar? Mere paas to is waqt 25 hi hain, aur mujhe tankhwah 10 ko milti hai

conversation.speaker: Zeeshan
conversation.text: Hotel sasta lete hain, jeep ke bajaye shared van, kharcha kam ho jayega

conversation.speaker: Taha
conversation.text: Sasta hotel ka matlab washroom aur gadde ka mukhtalif haal, mujhe wo pasand nahi

conversation.speaker: Hira
conversation.text: Taha tum bohot nakhre karte ho yaar, hum Naran ja rahe hain Dubai nahi

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Dono ki baat theek hai. Hotel darmiyani rakhte hain, 4 hazar raat ka, aur 3 din ke bajaye 4 din ka plan kar lete hain, is se bajet 28 hazar tak aa jayega

conversation.speaker: Zeeshan
conversation.text: 28 par main raazi hun, Hira tum bhi dekh lo

conversation.speaker: Hira
conversation.text: @Me tum poora hisaab ek sheet mein bana do na, taake mujhe pata ho ke har cheez ka kharcha kya hai

conversation.speaker: Anabia
conversation.text: Humare group mein Haris ne ab tak ek line bhi nahi likhi, aur kal presentation hai

conversation.speaker: Mustafa
conversation.text: Har dafa yehi hota hai, aur marks sab ko barabar milte hain

conversation.speaker: Haris
conversation.text: Yaar meri ammi ki tabiyat kharab thi, mujhe do din hospital mein rehna para

conversation.speaker: Anabia
conversation.text: Ye pehle bata dete to hum bhi samajh jate, bina bataye ghayab ho jana theek nahi

conversation.speaker: Haris
conversation.text: Mujhe sharmindagi hai, lekin ab kya karun?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Ab jo hua so hua. Haris, tum aaj raat conclusion aur references pura kar do, hum baqi slides sambhal lete hain, aur kal presentation mein tumhein sirf aakhri hissa bolna hoga

conversation.speaker: Mustafa
conversation.text: Ye taqseem theek hai, aur Haris ko kam se kam kuch to karna hi chahiye

conversation.speaker: Anabia
conversation.text: @Me tum Haris ko samjha do ke is dafa kuch bhi ho, waqt par bata dena, aur uska hissa bhi dekh lena ke theek bana hai ya nahi

conversation.speaker: Hina
conversation.text: Ammi ko Wednesday ko cardiologist ke paas le jana hai, kaun ja sakta hai?

conversation.speaker: Farhan
conversation.text: Wednesday ko mere office mein audit hai, main bilkul nahi nikal sakta

conversation.speaker: Hina
conversation.text: Mujhe bhi bachon ko school se lena hota hai, aur mere miyan bhi shehar se bahar hain

conversation.speaker: Farhan
conversation.text: Hum sab ko hamesha koi na koi bahana mil jata hai, aur ammi ka kaam latak jata hai

conversation.speaker: Hina
conversation.text: Ye bahana nahi hai Farhan, sab ki apni majburiyan hain

conversation.speaker: Me

conversation.text: Is dafa Sunday ko gali ke aakhri plot mein sab ke jaanwar rakh lein, wahan jagah bhi hai

conversation.speaker: Mr Hafeez
conversation.text: Lekin us plot ka maalik naraz hoga, wo to pichli baar bhi kuch kehta tha

conversation.speaker: Mrs Rubina
conversation.text: Phir qasai ka bhi bandobast chahiye, aur gandagi ke liye tarpal

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Main plot ke maalik se pehle ijazat le leta hun aur kehta hun ke hum safai ka poora zimma lete hain. Qasai bhi ek hi bula lete hain taake sab ke liye ek hi waqt tay ho, aur gandagi uthane ke liye do mazdoor bhi rakh lete hain

conversation.speaker: Adeel
conversation.text: Ye tareeqa acha hai, har ghar ke aage gandagi nahi hogi

conversation.speaker: Mr Hafeez
conversation.text: @Me tum ijazat le lo aur qasai se rate bhi tay kar lo, hum sab milkar kharcha baant lenge

conversation.speaker: Aqsa
conversation.text: Kal presentation hai aur Hamza ne abhi se kaha hai ke wo bol nahi sakega, uski tabiyat kharab hai

conversation.speaker: Hamza
conversation.text: Mujhe sach mein bohot ghabrahat hoti hai, haath kaampne lagte hain jab mein sab ke saamne khara hota hun

conversation.speaker: Rizwan
conversation.text: Ye to koi bahana nahi, sab ko khud ka hissa bolna parta hai

conversation.speaker: Aqsa
conversation.text: Rizwan, thori narmi se baat karo, sab ko ek jaise himmat nahi hoti

conversation.speaker: Hamza
conversation.text: Main slides bana sakta hun, bas bolne ka hissa kisi aur ko de do

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Hamza, tum sirf pehli slide ka ek chhota sa taruf bol do aur baqi presentation mein hum bolenge. Aaj shaam ek dafa mere saath practice karo, jab ek do dafa bol loge to ghabrahat kam ho jayegi

conversation.speaker: Rizwan
conversation.text: Theek hai, agar wo itna bhi kar le to marks ka masla nahi hoga

conversation.speaker: Hamza
conversation.text: @Me tum aaj shaam kitne baje free ho? Main sirf tumhare saamne bolne ki koshish kar sakta hun

conversation.text: Sab se zaroori Deosai ka sunrise hai, ye main kisi haal mein nahi chhodunga

conversation.text: Deosai ke liye ek poora din rakhte hain aur raat ko Skardu mein hi rukte hain taake subah jaldi nikal sakein. Garam kapray, thermos aur jeep ka pehle se intezam hona chahiye, aur sab se pehle mausam ki report dekh lenge

conversation.speaker: Sheharyar

conversation.text: Humare Faizan ka admission ke liye 3 jagah test hai, aur wo samajh nahi pa raha ke kahan jaye

conversation.text: NUST, FAST aur IBA ke test hain, teeno mein se kahan zyada chance hai?

conversation.text: NUST ki fees kam hai aur mahol bhi acha hai, lekin Islamabad mein rehna hoga

conversation.text: Ammi nahi chahti ke main ghar se door jaun

conversation.speaker: Me

conversation.speaker: Hamna
conversation.text: Ye bohot zaroori hai, aaj kal log bina saboot ke paise nahi dete

conversation.text: @Me tum appeal ka post bana do aur hisaab ka ek sheet bhi, hum sab usay share karenge

Agar na ho sake to 12 ko shaadi mein sirf nikah aur walima ke liye aa jana, baqi dino mein padhai par dhyan rakho

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Charger check kiya? Aur battery nikal ke dobara lagao

conversation.speaker: Daniyal
conversation.text: Sab kuch kiya. Kal raat tak toh chal raha tha

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Shayad RAM ya display cable ka masla hai. Service center ko dikhana parega

conversation.speaker: Daniyal
conversation.text: Warranty bhi nahi hai. Mein ne kaam ke liye laptop par bohat ummeed rakhi thi

conversation.speaker: Mehreen
conversation.text: Api mein ne aap ko batana tha. Mein ne Hamza se baat shuru ki hai. Mein usse pasand karti hun

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wo wahi Hamza hai jo tumhare saath university mein tha?

conversation.speaker: Mehreen
conversation.text: Haan wahi. Lekin abhi sirf dosti hai, ghar mein kisi ko nahi bataya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mujhe bata kar achha kiya. Lekin Abbu ko kab batao gi?

conversation.speaker: Mehreen
conversation.text: Jab pakka ho jaye ga. Abhi unko bata diya toh bohat bura mahol ban jayega

conversation.speaker: Kamran
conversation.text: Yaar kal Karachi Expo mein job fair hai. Chalo ek saath chalte hain

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kitne baje shuru hota hai? Aur kitni companies aayi hain?

conversation.speaker: Kamran
conversation.text: 10 baje se. 60 se zyada companies hain. Registration free hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mein apna CV print kar leta hun. Tum ne apna update kiya?

conversation.speaker: Kamran
conversation.text: Abhi karta hun. Tu mere liye bhi 5 copies nikalwa de, mere printer mein ink nahi hai

conversation.speaker: Ahmed
conversation.text: Abbu kal mere school mein parent teacher meeting hai. Aap aa sakenge?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kitne baje hai beta? Mujhe office se chhutti leni parti hai

conversation.speaker: Ahmed
conversation.text: Subah 10 baje. Miss ne kaha hai ke aap ka aana zaroori hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kya koi masla hai result mein? Pehle bata do taake mein tayyar ho kar aaun

conversation.speaker: Ahmed
conversation.text: Maths mein marks kam aaye hain. Baqi subjects mein theek hain

conversation.speaker: Sana
conversation.text: Aaj Ammi ke ghar se phone aya tha. Unhone kaha ke is Eid par hum wahan guzarein

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Pichli Eid bhi toh wahan guzari thi. Is dafa meri ammi ke paas jana hai

conversation.speaker: Sana
conversation.text: Mein jaanti hun, lekin Ammi ki tabiyat theek nahi aur wo akeli hain

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Chalo pehla din wahan guzarte hain, doosra mere ghar. Kya khayal hai?

conversation.speaker: Sana
conversation.text: Theek hai, lekin tum Ammi se thora narm bartao. Wo aap ki baat ka bura maan jati hain

conversation.speaker: Imtiaz
conversation.text: Sir aap ke account mein 50000 ka ek transaction hua hai jo mashkook lag raha hai. Kya aap ne kiya?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Nahi, mein ne koi transaction nahi kiya. Ye kab hua?

conversation.speaker: Imtiaz
conversation.text: Aaj subah 9:15 par, online. Mein aap ka card block kar raha hun taake aur nuksan na ho

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Haan block kar dein. Mujhe naya card kitne din mein mile ga?

conversation.speaker: Imtiaz
conversation.text: 7 se 10 din mein ghar par pohonch jaye ga. Aap branch aa kar form bhi bhar dein aur FIR ka rasta bhi dekhein

conversation.speaker: Zara
conversation.text: Yaar kiraya aur bills ka hisaab aaj raat mein kar lein? Mujhe kal ghar jana hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Haan bilkul. Bijli ka bill 7200 aya hai aur gas ka 1300

conversation.speaker: Zara
conversation.text: Hum 3 log hain toh 2833 per head. Kiraya alag hai, 15000 per head

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mein ne apna hissa aaj subah transfer kar diya tha. Dekh lo account mein

conversation.speaker: Zara
conversation.text: Haan aa gaya. Ayesha ne abhi tak nahi diya, us se tum baat kar lo

conversation.speaker: Rashid
conversation.text: Yaar mein ne kal ek bohat ghalat kaam kar diya. Boss ko email ke jagah group mein reply all kar diya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kya likha tha us mein? Kuch private tha?

conversation.speaker: Rashid
conversation.text: Mein ne uski policy ki shikayat likh di thi apne dost ko. Ab sab ko pata chal gaya hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Oh no. Boss ne kuch kaha?

conversation.speaker: Rashid
conversation.text: Abhi tak kuch nahi. Lekin subah se unki taraf se koi jawab nahi aya, aur mera dil dhad dhad kar raha hai

conversation.speaker: Mehak
conversation.text: Mujhe lagta hai mein ne weight bohat barha liya hai. Ab koi kapda poora nahi aata

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Tum ne kitni der se exercise chhor di thi?

conversation.speaker: Mehak
conversation.text: Lagbhag 6 mahine. Job ke baad time hi nahi milta

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Roz sirf 30 minute ki walk se shuru karo. Zyada tension mat lo

conversation.speaker: Mehak
conversation.text: Subah uthna bohat mushkil hota hai. Kya shaam ko chalein?

conversation.speaker: Hasan
conversation.text: Bhai ye wale Careem rides itni mehngi kyun ho gayi hain? Aaj 1800 ka bill aya airport tak

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Fuel ka rate aur surge pricing ki wajah se. Mein ab Bykea use karta hun

conversation.speaker: Hasan
conversation.text: Bike par saaman ke saath mushkil hota hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Phir InDrive try karo, wahan tum khud rate bargain kar sakte ho

conversation.speaker: Hasan
conversation.text: Ye achha hai. Mein ne suna hai usme drivers kam paise mein bhi chale jate hain

conversation.speaker: Ammar
conversation.text: Yaar kal ek mazedar cheez hui. Mein pizza lene gaya aur galti se doosre ka order utha laya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Haha kya? Phir wapas kiya ya khali bhi diya?

conversation.speaker: Ammar
conversation.text: Wapas karne gaya toh un ka launda mil gaya tha. Wo khud hi hans pada

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Chal acha tha. Khana kisi aur ka tha ya wohi?

conversation.speaker: Ammar
conversation.text: Wo ek mushroom pizza tha, mein toh peperoni mangwa kar aya tha. Bhookh itni thi ke kha liya

conversation.speaker: Ayaan
conversation.text: Mamu aap ne wada kiya tha mujhe cricket bat dilayenge. Kal aap ki chhutti hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Haan beta mujhe yaad hai. Konsa bat chahiye tumhein?

conversation.speaker: Ayaan
conversation.text: Aap ne kaha tha Gray Nicolls ka, 6000 ka. Mene ammi se bhi poochh liya hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Bhai 6000 toh bohat zyada hai. Kisi sasti brand ka dekh lein?

conversation.speaker: Ayaan
conversation.text: Mamu pichli dafa aap ne jo wada kiya tha wo poora nahi kiya tha. Plz is baar kar dein

conversation.speaker: Mrs. Saleem
conversation.text: Aap ke bete ka admission is session mein ho sakta hai, lekin fee structure ke baare mein aap ko batana tha

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Ji madam. Monthly fee kitni hogi aur admission ka kharcha alag hai kya?

conversation.speaker: Mrs. Saleem
conversation.text: Monthly 8500 hai aur admission fee 25000, jo sirf ek dafa deni hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Madam kya mere liye koi sibling discount ya waiver ka mauka hai? Meri bachi pehle se aap ke school mein hai

conversation.speaker: Mrs. Saleem
conversation.text: Haan, sibling ko 10 percent discount milta hai. Lekin application form ke saath aap ko document dene honge

conversation.speaker: Rizwana
conversation.text: Beta sham ko Bilal ko mere ghar bhej dena, usse kuch zaroori kaam hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Khala jaan wo abhi tuition gaya hai, aath baje tak aaye ga. Kya kaam hai?

conversation.speaker: Rizwana
conversation.text: Meri washing machine kharab ho gayi hai. Wo thora bohat mechanic ka kaam jaanta hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wo toh bike ka kaam karta hai. Aap kisi professional ko bulwa lein toh behtar hai

conversation.speaker: Rizwana
conversation.text: Beta mechanic toh 1500 se kam nahi leta. Bilal ek dafa dekh le toh shayad masla sasta hal ho jaye

conversation.speaker: Iqra
conversation.text: Yaar tum ne kitab wapas nahi ki jo mein ne tumhein Ramzan mein di thi

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Oh mujhe bilkul yaad nahi raha. Kaunsi wali thi?

conversation.speaker: Iqra
conversation.text: Wo Umera Ahmed ka novel. Meri ammi ne mere liye gift ki thi

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mein abhi dhoondh ke kal le aati hun. Maaf karna

conversation.speaker: Iqra
conversation.text: Koi masla nahi, bas mujhe woh bohat pasand hai isliye pooch rahi thi

conversation.speaker: Saad
conversation.text: Yaar kal client ki call mein tune mere sawal ka jawab nahi diya. Mujhe awkward laga

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mujhe maaf karna, mere mic mein masla tha, awaz kat rahi thi

conversation.speaker: Saad
conversation.text: Acha. Lekin phir tune msg mein bhi nahi bataya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Haan wo meri ghalti thi. Mujhe chat mein likhna chahiye tha

conversation.speaker: Saad
conversation.text: Koi baat nahi, bas aage se bata dena. Mein mushkil mein pad jata hun

conversation.speaker: Bina
conversation.text: Tumhari bhabhi ki baby shower ka gift lena hai. Kya dein?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wo pehle se baby ki cheezein jama kar rahi hain. Kuch khaas?

conversation.speaker: Bina
conversation.text: Mein sochti hun diaper bag aur stroller. Lekin mehnga hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Tum aur mein mil kar de dein toh 12000 mein ho jayega

conversation.speaker: Bina
conversation.text: Haan theek hai. Mein 6000 de sakti hun. Kya Khadda market se milta hai?

conversation.speaker: Hamid
conversation.text: Beta mujhe Hajj ke liye apply karna hai. Online form mein koi madad kar do

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Chacha ji bilkul. Kya aap ke paas CNIC aur passport hai?

conversation.speaker: Hamid
conversation.text: CNIC hai, passport banwana baqi hai. Wo kitne din mein ho jata hai?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Normal mein 2 se 3 hafte, urgent mein 7 din. Mein aap ko bata dunga kahan se karwana hai

conversation.speaker: Hamid
conversation.text: Allah tumhein khush rakhe. Mein bohat pareshan tha ke online kaam mere liye mushkil hai

conversation.speaker: Sehrish
conversation.text: Aaj mera exam result aya. Mein ne distinction le li!

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wah Sehrish, mubarak ho! Kitne percent aaye?

conversation.speaker: Sehrish
conversation.text: 86 percent. Mein ne socha tha ke 75 bhi mushkil se aaye ga

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Tum ne itni mehnat ki thi. Ghar mein sab ko bataya?

conversation.speaker: Sehrish
conversation.text: Abhi toh sirf tumhein bataya hai. Mein ghar ja kar sab ko surprise dungi

conversation.speaker: Fiza
conversation.text: Mein ne apni nayi jagah par shift kar liya, lekin yahan pe kuch dost nahi hain. Bohat akeli feel hoti hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kaunsi jagah shift hui ho? Aur kitne din ho gaye?

conversation.speaker: Fiza
conversation.text: Islamabad. Teen hafte hue hain. Office mein sab apne apne kaam mein hain

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Teen hafte toh bohat kam hain. Kisi hobby class ya group mein join karo, wahan log mil jate hain

conversation.speaker: Fiza
conversation.text: Mein ne ek book club ke baare mein suna hai. Shayad chali jaun

conversation.speaker: Taimoor
conversation.text: Yaar kya ye sach hai ke tu abroad ja raha hai? Mujhe Faisal ne bataya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Haan yaar, Canada ka PR process chal raha hai. Abhi final nahi hua

conversation.speaker: Taimoor
conversation.text: Hum ne toh socha tha ke ek saath business shuru karenge. Ab tu bhi chala jayega

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mein ne tujhe pehle bhi bataya tha, ye mere liye bohat badi opportunity hai

conversation.speaker: Taimoor
conversation.text: Haan pata hai. Bas yaar tere bina yahan bohat akela ho jaunga

conversation.speaker: Mrs. Hussain
conversation.text: Beta kal plumber aaya tha lekin kitchen ka nalka abhi bhi band hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Aunty ji maine bhi dekha tha. Plumber ne kya kaha?

conversation.speaker: Mrs. Hussain
conversation.text: Usne kaha ke puri pipe badalni parti hai. 6000 ka kharcha bata raha hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Aunty ji kya ye kharcha owner ki taraf se hota hai? Kyunke pipe puraani hai

conversation.speaker: Mrs. Hussain
conversation.text: Mein ek dafa apne bete se poochh leti hun. Lekin kiraydaar ko bhi kuch hissa dena hota hai

conversation.speaker: Adeel
conversation.text: Yaar mere liye ek favour karoge? Mujhe Monday ko kisi ko airport chhorna hai lekin meri gaari service pe hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kitne baje ki flight hai aur kahan jana hai?

conversation.speaker: Adeel
conversation.text: Subah 6 baje ki, Dubai ki. Meri khala ja rahi hain

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mein 4:30 pe tum ko pick kar leta hun. Kya khala ka saman zyada hai?

conversation.speaker: Adeel
conversation.text: Do bari suitcases aur ek chhota bag hai. Mein tumhein fuel ke paise de dunga

conversation.speaker: Salma
conversation.text: Beta tum ne phir se khana nahi khaya? Subah se kuch nahi khaya hoga

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Ammi mein ne chai aur biscuit liye the. Office mein kaam bohat tha

conversation.speaker: Salma
conversation.text: Ye koi khana hua? Mein ne tumhare liye paratha aur anda rakh diya tha

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mujhe pata hai Ammi, lekin jaldi mein nikal gaya tha

conversation.speaker: Salma
conversation.text: Raat ko ghar aao toh garam garam khana banaungi. Pet bhar ke khana khana

conversation.speaker: Waleed
conversation.text: Yaar mere pass ek business idea hai. Online kapdon ka brand banana hai, Instagram par

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Achha idea hai. Kis qism ke kapde aur kis audience ke liye?

conversation.speaker: Waleed
conversation.text: Women ke kurtay aur dupatte. Mein ne kuch designers se baat ki hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Pehle ek sample collection tayyar karo aur dekho ke response kya milta hai

conversation.speaker: Waleed
conversation.text: Haan wohi soch raha tha. Kya tum photography ka kaam sambhal sakte ho? Tumhara kaam bohat achha hai

conversation.speaker: Rafay
conversation.text: Bhai tune sunna? Hamari school ki purani class ka reunion ho raha hai next month

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wah kamaal hai. Kaun organize kar raha hai?

conversation.speaker: Rafay
conversation.text: Asad aur Hira. Wo log apne ghar par hi arrange karna chahte hain, lagbhag 25 log honge

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mujhe sach mein bohat din ho gaye sab ko dekhe hue. Kya mein khana lane mein madad kar sakta hun?

conversation.speaker: Rafay
conversation.text: Bohat achha hoga. Wo log abhi budget ka decide kar rahe hain, mein tujhe group mein add kar deta hun

conversation.speaker: Owais
conversation.text: Yaar kal raat load shedding ki wajah se mera assignment save nahi hua. Poora kaam zaya ho gaya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Oh no. Auto save on nahi tha kya? Ya UPS wagera?

conversation.speaker: Owais
conversation.text: Word ka auto recover bhi khali aya. UPS ki battery do mahine se kharab hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Temp folder mein check kiya? Kabhi kabhi wahan purani copy mil jati hai

conversation.speaker: Owais
conversation.text: Nahi kiya. Mujhe bata na kahan dekhun? Submission kal subah 9 baje hai

conversation.speaker: Sumbal
conversation.text: Api tum Ammi ki salgirah par kya pakane wali ho? Mein cake mangwa lun?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Cake tum mangwa lo, Chocolate wala jo wo pasand karti hain. Mein biryani aur raita bana lungi

conversation.speaker: Sumbal
conversation.text: Theek hai. Kitne mehman aayenge? Mein table ka intezam kar lun?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Lagbhag 15 log. Khala aur unke bache bhi aa rahe hain

conversation.speaker: Sumbal
conversation.text: Chalo phir ghar ki safai bhi kal se shuru kar dein. Ammi ko pata nahi chalna chahiye

conversation.speaker: Mr. Arif
conversation.text: Aap ka income tax return ki last date 30 tareekh hai. Aap ke documents abhi tak nahi aaye

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Ji Arif sahab, mein salary slips aur bank statements kal bhej deta hun

conversation.speaker: Mr. Arif
conversation.text: Sath mein zakat ya charity ki receipts bhi bhejiye, un par rebate mil sakta hai

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Kya rent ka agreement bhi chahiye? Mein kiraye ke ghar mein rehta hun

conversation.speaker: Mr. Arif
conversation.text: Haan wo bhi bhej dein. Filing se pehle ek dafa sab check kar ke aap ko bata dunga

conversation.speaker: Asma
conversation.text: Aaj mera bohat bura din tha. Client ne sab ke saamne meri report ki burai ki

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Oh yaar bohat bura laga hoga. Kya galat tha us mein?

conversation.speaker: Asma
conversation.text: Un ko lagta hai ke numbers purane hain. Halanki data wohi tha jo unhon ne bheja tha

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Mein tumhare saath tha us meeting mein. Tum ne bohat achhe se jawab diya

conversation.speaker: Asma
conversation.text: Shukriya. Lekin mujhe aisa lag raha hai ke ab mere boss ki nazar mein meri image kharab ho gayi

conversation.speaker: Areeba
conversation.text: Yaar mere pass ek khushkhabri hai. Mein ne apni pehli salary se Ammi ko ek gift diya

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wah Areeba! Kya diya? Mubarak ho pehli kamai ki

conversation.speaker: Areeba
conversation.text: Ek sone ki angoothi. Unhon ne zindagi mein kabhi apne liye kuch nahi kharida

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Ye toh bohat pyari baat hai. Ammi ka reaction kaisa tha?

conversation.speaker: Areeba
conversation.text: Wo ro padin. Aur mujhe bohat dua di. Yeh pal mein kabhi nahi bhoolungi
